sub_answers.text: In 2015, the Trinidad and Tobago Creative Industries Company Limited (CreativeTT) was established as a state agency under the Ministry of Trade and Industry. [d3565457s47p0] The agency’s mandate is to stimulate and facilitate the business development and export activities of the Creative Industries in Trinidad and Tobago to generate national wealth. [d3565457s47p0] It is responsible for the strategic and business development of the three niche areas under its purview: Music, Film and Fashion. [d3565457s47p0]
